Non-additivity of chain-linked volume measures

Source: R/chain_tools.R
chain_discrepancy.Rd

Chain-linked volume measures are not additive: the chain volume measure of the total differs from the sum of the chain volume measures of its components (except in the base year and, with the annual overlap technique, in the year after the base year). This function returns the difference, with the sign of the column "Discrepancies" of the examples 8.6 and 8.7 of the manual: the sum of the components minus the total, $$D_t = \sum_i x_{i,t} - z_t,$$ with \(x_{i,t}\) the chain volume measures of the components and \(z_t\) the one of the total (\(100\, D_t / z_t\) with relative = TRUE).

Usage

chain_discrepancy(vo, vo_total = NULL, relative = FALSE)

Arguments

vo

Chain volume measures (in monetary terms) of the components (ts or mts). If vo_total is NULL, the last column is the total (as returned by chain_laspeyres() with output = "measure").

vo_total

Chain volume measure of the total (ts).

relative

Boolean: if TRUE, the discrepancy is expressed in percent of the chain volume measure of the total.

Value

A ts: sum of the chain volume measures of the components minus the chain volume measure of the total.

References

International Monetary Fund (2018), Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017 Edition), chapter 8 "Price and Volume Measures", Washington, DC. doi:10.5089/9781475589870.069 .

See also

chain_contrib()

Examples

x <- chain_laspeyres(imf_cp, imf_pi, method = "ao", base_year = 2010,
           output = "measure")
chain_discrepancy(x)
#>               Qtr1          Qtr2          Qtr3          Qtr4
#> 2011  0.000000e+00  0.000000e+00 -1.136868e-13 -5.684342e-14
#> 2012 -1.731737e-01 -4.568221e-01 -8.374144e-01 -1.808633e+00
#> 2013 -3.080118e+00 -4.003720e+00 -4.630056e+00 -4.931551e+00
chain_discrepancy(x, relative = TRUE)
#>               Qtr1          Qtr2          Qtr3          Qtr4
#> 2011  0.000000e+00  0.000000e+00 -3.012192e-14 -1.501428e-14
#> 2012 -4.564664e-02 -1.204342e-01 -2.196390e-01 -4.700788e-01
#> 2013 -7.925857e-01 -1.024582e+00 -1.185103e+00 -1.264084e+00
